findings.title: Command Injection via child_process
findings.reason: The Express route passes req.body.url directly into child_process.exec. This supports the source-level shell-injection warning if the route is deployed/reachable. No command was executed.

findings.title: Command Injection
findings.reason: os.system is present, but its argument is request.remote_addr, ordinarily a peer IP address. Shell-metacharacter control depends on deployment/proxy semantics not shown; this is not a demonstrated arbitrary request-string injection.

findings.title: Untrusted text controls server-side template source
findings.reason: The form value has braces removed before session storage/interpolation, preventing default Jinja tag delimiters on the observed path. The literal template also contains malformed Jinja tags. Arbitrary preexisting session compromise is not demonstrated.

findings.title: External input controls a filesystem path
findings.reason: A request parameter is interpolated into the open path without containment enforcement; the substring flag check is not a path-containment guard. The two source files are identical, not independent mechanisms. Runtime was not tested.

findings.title: XSS via innerHTML
findings.reason: The assigned username passes through html_encode, implemented with createTextNode and DOM serialization. In this HTML text context the supplied characters are encoded before innerHTML assignment.

findings.title: External input crosses a session storage boundary
